quote_english: Around 28 crore LED bulbs have been distributed under the Ujala scheme, saving about Rs 14,000 crore (paraphrase from FactChecker's list).
summary: Government Ujala data showed about 27.8 crore LED bulbs distributed and annual savings of about Rs 14,450 crore at the time of the check.

evidence.key_figure: 278.2 million bulbs; Rs 14,450 crore annual savings

analysis:
FactChecker checked 16 claims from Modi's 30 November 2017 HT Leadership Summit speech and rated the LED claim true.

The UJALA dashboard on 6 December 2017 showed 278.2 million bulbs distributed and estimated annual savings of Rs 14,450 crore. Note the savings are the programme's own estimates; the fact-checker verified the claim against official data, not through independent audit.
notes: Figures are the government's own programme data. Quote is a paraphrase; the speech transcript was not retrieved in full. No video link found.
